historical_values_origin: Recovered from preserved reports with row-specific file/line references; not newly recomputed from absent old outputs.
paper_qdiag_scope: pilot500 / all: 499 groups with accepted edits, 1862 instructions, 5576 edits; 500 groups retained for calibration. Distinct from newer full-release 10131-edit rank-alignment audit.
pinpoint_units: CSV exports multiply historical 0-1 PinPoint metrics by 100. CIRR and FashionIQ already percentages.
extra_models: Four completed checkpoints: CLIP4CIR CIRR RN50x4, TEMA MCIRR, MagicLens CLIP Base and Large. QuRe CIRR was skipped because weights were unavailable.

head_protocol.student: OpenAI CLIP ViT-L/14, identical original checkpoint in all runs
head_protocol.initialization: Official randomly initialized heads; no published CIRR or MagicLens fine-tuned student weights
head_protocol.objective: Original CLIP-L OPRD: reverse KL, T=0.05, student top32 each epoch, force target, no teacher filtering
head_protocol.optimizer: 4 epochs, batch32, AdamW head1e-5/backbone5e-7, seed42, bf16
head_protocol.preprocessing: Identical original HF CLIP preprocessing in all three experiments; this is an exact head architecture ablation on one backbone, not a reproduction of the full pretrained external systems
evaluations: QDiag all and ADD/SUBSTITUTE/DELETE, hierarchical aggregation and bootstrap2000 seed42
head_protocol.selection: Fixed epoch4, no QDiag checkpoint selection

original_head_comparison_sources.units: all five performance columns are percentages
original_head_comparison_sources.CRR_subset: all; includes ADD, SUBSTITUTE, DELETE; not strict
original_head_comparison_sources.common_recipe: CLIP-L/14, BGE-VL-MLLM-S2, OPRD reverse KL T=0.05, on-policy K=32 with target insertion, seed42, epoch4
original_head_comparison_sources.comparison_type: Historical original-head results compared with new-head runs; not a same-run retraining of all four heads

limitations: Some historical run directories are absent at their original paths. Their log/report values survive, but full per-query artifacts are not claimed for every historical model.
On-policy without target insertion has strict CRR=10.1565%; its all-operation CRR is not present in the located historical records and remains blank.
Use QWEN_COMPLETED_EXPERIMENTS_RESULTS.md for final trained Qwen rows; older Qwen rows in PAPER_MAIN_TABLES.md describe different earlier runs.
Original-head versus new-head comparison uses preserved historical original-head results and later new-head runs; it is not a same-run retraining of all four heads.
